# Roman Matviy - Senior Web Developer Portfolio & Blog

> Professional web development services, technical blog, and portfolio of Roman Matviy. Specializing in PHP, Laravel, Next.js, React, WordPress, and E-commerce solutions.

This website serves as the central hub for my professional services, technical articles, and portfolio. It is available in both Ukrainian and Russian languages.

## About the Author
Roman Matviy is a Senior Web Developer with over 7 years of experience in building robust backend systems, high-converting e-commerce platforms, and modern frontend applications.

## Services Offered
- Custom Web Development (Laravel, Next.js)
- E-Commerce Development (PrestaShop, WooCommerce, Custom)
- PHP & Backend Development
- WordPress Development & Optimization
- SEO Optimization Services
